messages.content: Where is the best carbonate near me?

I'll check the site and the carbonate evidence.The best carbonate near you is a small confirmed patch about 1.4 km away, site 2.2 at (1407, -1069) — around 1.4 km of walking, mean slope about 6 degrees.

- It's **confirmed in situ**: Perseverance measured carbonate in samples 4 and 5 (Salette, Coulettes) there, so it's a rover-confirmed claim rather than an orbital signature (Farley et al. 2022). The next one, Robine/Malay, is a bit farther at 1.52 km.
- Caveat: these are unit-level sample statements placed at approximate positions (10–50 m), and the CRISM pixel caveat applies to nearby tier changes.
- The big orbital-only carbonate areas (strong_orbital, MRO/CRISM) sit 6–7 km out toward the crater rim.

Want me to plan a route to the Salette/Coulettes spot?

360 site(s) for clay (evidence); top 5, ranked by best evidence tier then area, from rover (2393, -81). Stored as set:3.
Resolved: clay -> fe_mg_smectite, kaolinite, mg_smectite_2 (sites are where any of these 3 layers is present; each site lists the evidence of every one).
1. 3.1 (-3115, 2909) m, best tier 3 strong_orbital, region area 11124832 m2 (11.12 km2) in total (whole region, not the area at the best tier); by tier: strong_orbital 3672 m2 (0.004 km2) [orbital: MRO/CRISM], weak_orbital 10994656 m2 (10.99 km2) [orbital: MRO/CRISM], not_detected 126504 m2 (0.127 km2) [covered by MRO/CRISM, nothing detected: absence of evidence]; mean slope 6.7 deg, 6267 m (6.27 km) away, reachable (6747 m (6.75 km) walk); layer fe_mg_smectite
2. 3.2 (-3931, -2057) m, best tier 3 strong_orbital, region area 937008 m2 (0.937 km2) in total (whole region, not the area at the best tier); by tier: strong_orbital 1224 m2 (0.001 km2) [orbital: MRO/CRISM], weak_orbital 2520 m2 (0.003 km2) [orbital: MRO/CRISM], not_detected 933264 m2 (0.933 km2) [covered by MRO/CRISM, nothing detected: absence of evidence]; mean slope 7.1 deg, 6626 m (6.63 km) away, reachable (7152 m (7.15 km) walk); layer kaolinite
3. 3.3 (199, 2323) m, best tier 3 strong_orbital, region area 304848 m2 (0.305 km2) in total (whole region, not the area at the best tier); by tier: strong_orbital 2448 m2 (0.002 km2) [orbital: MRO/CRISM], weak_orbital 8568 m2 (0.009 km2) [orbital: MRO/CRISM], not_detected 293832 m2 (0.294 km2) [covered by MRO/CRISM, nothing detected: absence of evidence]; mean slope 12.8 deg, 3255 m (3.25 km) away, reachable (3314 m (3.31 km) walk); layer kaolinite
4. 3.4 (969, 1545) m, best tier 3 strong_orbital, region area 143784 m2 (0.144 km2) in total (whole region, not the area at the best tier); by tier: strong_orbital 1224 m2 (0.001 km2) [orbital: MRO/CRISM], weak_orbital 138888 m2 (0.139 km2) [orbital: MRO/CRISM], not_detected 3672 m2 (0.004 km2) [covered by MRO/CRISM, nothing detected: absence of evidence]; mean slope 13 deg, 2161 m (2.16 km) away, reachable (2218 m (2.22 km) walk); layer fe_mg_smectite
5. 3.5 (3929, 1777) m, best tier 3 strong_orbital, region area 142488 m2 (0.142 km2) in total (whole region, not the area at the best tier); by tier: strong_orbital 32976 m2 (0.033 km2) [orbital: MRO/CRISM], weak_orbital 107064 m2 (0.107 km2) [orbital: MRO/CRISM], not_detected 2448 m2 (0.002 km2) [covered by MRO/CRISM, nothing detected: absence of evidence]; mean slope 12.1 deg, 2411 m (2.41 km) away, NOT reachable; layer fe_mg_smectite
fe_mg_smectite, kaolinite, mg_smectite_2 caveat: within 36 m of a tier change; CRISM pixels are 36 m and the registration residual to our terrain was not measured, so the tier here may belong to the neighbouring pixel.
Orbital tiers are detections from orbit, not abundance; region extents follow pixel/polygon boundaries and are uncertain by the stated distance. Hint: Call describe_location on a region point, or nearest(from=set:3, to=<pad set>) for the closest pads. Sites 3.5 are not reachable from rover with the rover_scout slope limit (they are cut off by steep or unknown ground).
Next: set_view(highlights=[ids]) to show them, plan_route(goal="<id>") to get there.
